name: Hao Yan
bio: My name is Hao Yan (颜浩), and I also go by Sherirto. I am a Ph.D. student in Computer Science at Central South University, supervised by Prof. Senzhang Wang, with expected graduation in June 2027. From September 2025 to August 2026, I participated in the Joint Ph.D. Supervision Scheme at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University as a fully funded Research Assistant, supervised by Prof. Chengqi Zhang. I also receive research supervision from Prof. Shirui Pan.
availability: Seeking research and engineering opportunities for 2027 in multimodal learning, graph–language models, and agent systems.

projects.name: Scientific agents for synthesis process design
projects.description: Built a MinerU-based pipeline for batch PDF-to-Markdown conversion and multimodal chart descriptions. Collaborated on tool interfaces and reusable Skills for correlation analysis and inverse screening of process conditions. Designed visual workflows for inspecting analysis steps and tracing results.

projects.name: SUPRA · Robust multimodal graph learning
projects.role: Principal investigator · CSU graduate research project
projects.description: Investigating robustness to missing modalities and noisy topology. Designed a decoupled, prior-retaining architecture, with theoretical analysis and experimental validation.
